stories.headline: Google Cloud launches Gemini agent
stories.summary: Google Cloud announced Gemini agent, a work assistant that plans tasks, uses tools, and fits enterprise controls.
stories.why_it_matters: Google is betting on a universal business agent for office workflows.

stories.headline: NSF announces new AI science programs
stories.summary: The U.S. NSF said it will launch new programs to support AI for discovery, metascience, and early-career talent.
stories.why_it_matters: Public funding could shape the next wave of U.S. AI research.

stories.headline: UW–Madison starts embodied AI initiative
stories.summary: UW–Madison launched a campuswide embodied AI initiative focused on autonomous systems that work safely with people.
stories.why_it_matters: Embodied AI is moving from papers into coordinated campus research.
